title: Headgear and parts thereof
notes: This chapter covers hats, caps, and other headgear. Heading 6503 is not used (reserved). Safety headgear (e.g., hard hats, crash helmets) is generally classified under heading 6506.

headings.description: Hat-forms, hat bodies and hoods of felt, neither blocked to shape nor with made brims; plateaux and manchons (including slit manchons), of felt

children.description: Hat-forms, hat bodies and hoods of felt; plateaux and manchons of felt
children.notes: Unfinished felt forms for hat making. These are intermediate products, not finished hats.

headings.description: Hat-shapes, plaited or made by assembling strips of any material, neither blocked to shape, nor with made brims, nor lined, nor trimmed

children.description: Hat-shapes, plaited or assembled from strips
children.notes: Unfinished plaited/braided hat forms. Includes straw, palm leaf, and similar materials.

headings.description: Hats and other headgear, plaited or made by assembling strips of any material, whether or not lined or trimmed

children.description: Hats and other headgear, plaited or assembled from strips
children.notes: Finished hats made from plaited or braided strips. Classic Panama hats are classified here.

headings.description: Hats and other headgear, knitted or crocheted, or made up from lace, felt or other textile fabric, in the piece (but not in strips), whether or not lined or trimmed; hair-nets of any material, whether or not lined or trimmed

children.description: Hats and headgear, knitted or crocheted, or made from textile fabric; hair-nets
children.notes: The most commonly used heading for fashion headwear. Covers knitted hats (beanies), felt hats (fedoras, trilbys), and fabric hats (baseball caps, bucket hats).

headings.description: Other headgear, whether or not lined or trimmed

children.notes: Does not include sports helmets classified elsewhere (e.g., bicycle helmets may be here or under other headings depending on country)

headings.description: Head-bands, linings, covers, hat foundations, hat frames, peaks (visors) and chin straps, for headgear

children.description: Head-bands, linings, covers, hat foundations, hat frames, peaks and chin straps
